items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎中胰腺腺泡细胞自噬功能障碍：从分子机制与胰蛋白酶原激活到异质性与治疗意义
items.title_en: Autophagy dysfunction in pancreatic acinar cells in acute pancreatitis: from molecular mechinery and trypsinogen activation to heterogeneity and therapeutic implications.
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是消化系统常见的急危重症，其发病机制的首要步骤是胰蛋白酶原在胰腺腺泡细胞内的异常激活。关键性研究已证实自噬功能障碍是该过程中的关键上游调控环节。在生理条件下，选择性自噬（如酶原自噬）可清除细胞内异常激活的酶原颗粒，维持胰腺稳态。然而在AP中，自噬流缺陷表现为自噬体-溶酶体融合障碍、溶酶体酶活性降低、微管相关蛋白轻链3 II（LC3-II）和螯合体1（p62）蓄积，从而诱导胰蛋白酶原错误分选和过早激活，启动胰腺自身消化级联反应。由此形成涉及哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白（mTOR）/AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）、核因子κB（NF-κB）和活性氧（ROS）通路，以及自噬相关16样蛋白1（ATG16L1）、液泡膜蛋白1（VMP1）和微小RNA 155等关键调控因子的"自噬-胰酶轴"恶性循环。此外，不同病因AP（如胆源性、酒精性、高脂血症性急性胰腺炎）的自噬功能障碍机制存在异质性。目前，雷帕霉素、大黄素及miR-155抑制剂等干预策略已在动物模型中显示出调控自噬、减轻胰腺损伤的潜力，但临床转化仍面临靶点特异性、干预时机及自噬在AP中的双重作用等挑战。未来研究应聚焦于深入解析人胰腺组织关键分子机制、开发组织特异性自噬调控剂，并结合病因分型与生物标志物推动AP个体化治疗策略。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common acute and critical disease of the digestive system. The initial step of its pathogenesis is the abnormal activation of trypsinogen within pancreatic acinar cells. Seminal studies have identified autophagy dysfunction as a critical upstream regulatory step in this process. Under physiological conditions, selective autophagy, such as zymophagy, may clear aberrantly activated zymogen particles in the cell and maintain pancreatic homeostasis. However, in AP defective autophagic flux, manifested by a defect in autophagosome-lysosome fusion, decreased lysosomal enzyme activity, and accumulation of microtubule-associated protein light chain 3 II (LC3-II) and sequestosome 1 (p62), induces trypsinogen missorting and premature activation. This starts the pancreatic autodigestion cascade. This results in a vicious cycle of an "autophagy pancreatic enzyme axis" involving the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR)/AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB), and reactive oxygen species (ROS) pathways and key regulators such as autophagy-related 16-like protein 1 (ATG16L1), vacuole membrane protein 1 (VMP1), and microRNA 155. Moreover, the mechanism of autophagy dysfunction is heterogeneous among the etiologies of AP, such as biliary, alcoholic, and hyperlipidemic acute pancreatitis. Currently, intervention strategies such as rapamycin, emodin, and miR-155 inhibitors have shown potential in regulating autophagy and reducing pancreatic injury in animal models. However, there are still challenges to clinical translation, including the target specificity, the timing of intervention, and the dual role of autophagy in AP. Future studies should focus on in-depth analysis of the mechanism of key molecules in human pancreatic tissue, development of tissue-specific autophagy regulators, and combining etiology typing and biomarkers to promote individualized treatment strategies of AP.
items.summary_cn: 自噬功能障碍是急性胰腺炎中胰蛋白酶原异常激活的关键上游调控步骤，表现为自噬流缺陷（如自噬体-溶酶体融合障碍、溶酶体酶活性下降）导致胰蛋白酶原错误分选和提前激活，启动胰腺自身消化级联反应。

items.title_en: Prognostic factors analysis of ultrasound-guided percutaneous puncture drainage in severe acute pancreatitis with peripancreatic fluid collection

items.title_cn: 牵引辅助下使用S-O夹行内镜逆行胰胆管造影术处理Billroth II重建术后肿瘤相关变形所致困难胆管插管
items.title_en: Traction-assisted Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography Using an S-O Clip for Difficult Biliary Cannulation in Billroth II Reconstruction With Tumor-associated Distortion.
items.abstract_cn: 内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）在手术解剖结构改变的患者中具有技术挑战性，尤其是当乳头相对于内镜方向不佳时。我们报告一例采用S-O夹牵引辅助ERCP处理Billroth II重建合并肿瘤相关畸形的困难胆管插管病例。患者因胃癌行远端胃切除术及Billroth II重建，现因复发性胃癌导致胆管狭窄而出现梗阻性黄疸。在双气囊小肠镜辅助ERCP过程中，输入袢的扭曲导致乳头明显方向异常，使得标准胆管插管困难。为改善乳头可视化，将一枚S-O夹置于乳头口侧黏膜皱襞上，并将袢环固定于肛侧肠壁以形成夹-壁牵引。该操作改善了乳头开口的正面可视性并稳定了胆管轴向，从而使用MTW ERCP导管及导丝成功完成胆管插管。随后顺利完成内镜下乳头括约肌切开术及塑料支架置入术，未发生不良事件。尽管已有类似牵引辅助ERCP技术的报道，本病例突显了该方法在肿瘤相关畸形中的实用性——牵引虽未显著改变乳头位置，但提供了足够的正面视野以完成胆管插管。对于解剖结构改变且乳头方向受损的特定病例，牵引辅助ERCP可能是一种有用的辅助技术。
items.abstract_en: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) in patients with surgically altered anatomy is technically challenging, especially when the papilla is poorly oriented relative to the endoscope. We report a case of traction-assisted ERCP using an S-O clip for difficult biliary cannulation in a patient with Billroth II reconstruction and tumor-associated distortion. A patient with a history of distal gastrectomy with Billroth II reconstruction for gastric cancer presented with obstructive jaundice caused by recurrent gastric cancer with biliary stricture. During double-balloon enteroscopy-assisted ERCP, marked papillary malorientation due to distortion of the afferent limb made standard biliary cannulation difficult. To improve papillary visualization, an S-O clip was placed on a mucosal fold on the oral side of the papilla, and the loop was anchored to the anal-side intestinal wall to create clip-to-wall traction. This maneuver improved frontal visualization of the papillary orifice and stabilized the biliary axis, allowing successful biliary cannulation with an MTW ERCP catheter and guidewire. Endoscopic sphincterotomy and plastic stent placement were then completed without adverse events. Although similar traction-assisted ERCP techniques have been reported, this case highlights the usefulness of the method in tumor-associated distortion, where traction did not dramatically reposition the papilla but provided sufficient frontal visualization for biliary cannulation. Traction-assisted ERCP may be a useful adjunctive technique in selected cases with altered anatomy and compromised papillary orientation.
items.summary_cn: 该研究报道了一种使用S-O夹进行牵引辅助ERCP的技术，成功解决了Billroth II术后因肿瘤相关解剖扭曲导致的困难胆管插管问题，证实了该技术在乳头方向异常时提供正面视野的有效性。

items.title_cn: 联动成像在人工智能辅助早期胃癌诊断中的优势：一项倾向评分调整的初步研究
items.title_en: Benefit of Linked-Color Imaging in Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Diagnosis of Early Gastric Cancer: A Pilot Study With Propensity Score Adjustment.
items.abstract_cn: 背景与目的：人工智能辅助内镜是一种前景广阔的病变检测方法，但频繁的假阳性检测会干扰检查流程、降低医生信心，从而损害其临床实用性。联动成像技术（LCI）作为一种图像增强内镜技术，可增强黏膜与血管对比度，可能解决这一局限。本研究评估了与白光成像（WLI）相比，LCI是否能减少人工智能的假阳性检测。方法：本回顾性研究分析了2024年3月至2025年6月期间连续进行的人工智能辅助上消化道内镜检查。每位患者在同一内镜操作中依次进行WLI和LCI检查。使用两种计算机辅助检测（CAD）版本比较两种模式下的假阳性人工智能检测结果。采用倾向性评分校正作为CAD版本I与II之间基线差异的敏感性分析。结果：在最初筛选的66例病例中，排除既往有胃部手术史的患者后剩余63例。与WLI相比，LCI减少了假阳性人工智能检测（中位数2次 vs. 5次；结论：在WLI观察后进行LCI评估可减少CAD-EYE的假阳性检测，同时保持病变检测敏感性。然而，由于观察顺序固定，这些结果应谨慎解读，并需在前瞻性或交叉平衡研究中加以验证。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted endoscopy represents a promising approach for lesion detection, yet frequent false-positive detections impair clinical utility by disrupting examinations and diminishing physician confidence. Linked-color imaging (LCI), an image-enhanced endoscopy technique that amplifies mucosal and vascular contrast, may address this limitation. This investigation evaluated whether LCI reduces false-positive AI detections compared with white-light imaging (WLI). METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed consecutive AI-assisted upper endoscopies performed between March 2024 and June 2025. WLI and LCI were performed sequentially within the same endoscopic session in each patient. False-positive AI detections were compared between modalities using two computer-aided detection (CAD) versions. Propensity score adjustment was used as a sensitivity analysis for baseline differences between CAD Versions I and II. RESULTS: Of 66 initially screened cases, 63 remained after excluding patients with prior gastric surgery. LCI reduced false-positive AI detections compared with WLI (median 2 vs. 5; CONCLUSIONS: LCI assessment performed after WLI observation yielded fewer false-positive CAD-EYE detections while maintaining lesion detection sensitivity. However, because the observation sequence was fixed, these findings should be interpreted cautiously and require confirmation in prospective or counterbalanced studies.
items.summary_cn: LCI在AI辅助上消化道内镜检查中相比WLI能减少假阳性检测（中位数2 vs 5），同时保持病变检出敏感性。

items.title_cn: IL-22Rα1不依赖其C端STAT3扩增结构域抑制胰腺损伤
items.title_en: IL-22Rα1 restrains pancreatic injury independently of its C-terminal STAT3-amplifying domain.
items.abstract_cn: 白细胞介素-22（IL-22）是一种主要通过激活STAT3信号通路调节组织炎症与修复的细胞因子。尽管其在急性胰腺炎（AP）中的保护作用已得到充分证实，但其受体IL-22Ra1的具体贡献及潜在信号机制仍未完全明确。值得注意的是，IL-22Ra1的C端区域虽缺乏酪氨酸残基，但已有研究报道其可通过非经典机制促进STAT3活化。本研究在雨蛙素诱导的AP小鼠模型中探讨了IL-22Ra1及其C端（STAT3相关）结构域的作用。我们发现，缺失IL-22Ra1的C端区域可显著降低胰腺中STAT3的活化水平，证实了该区域在放大经典信号通路中的作用。出乎意料的是，这种STAT3活化的降低并未加重胰腺损伤。相反，IL-22基因缺陷小鼠和IL-22Ra1基因缺陷小鼠均出现更严重的胰腺炎表现，其特征为血清淀粉酶水平升高、炎症反应加剧及组织损伤加重。值得注意的是，IL-22Ra1缺陷导致的表型比单纯IL-22缺陷更为严重，表明IL-22Ra1介导了超越IL-22信号通路的保护效应。与此一致的是，在再生阶段，IL-22缺陷和IL-22Ra1缺陷小鼠的腺泡-导管化生均受损，而C端截短小鼠的该过程得以保留。综上所述，这些发现表明IL-22Ra1通过独立于最大STAT3活化且超越IL-22本身的机制，成为胰腺保护的核心调控因子，提示存在其他IL-22Ra1配体的参与。该结果支持探索受体激活策略（如激动性抗体）以促进组织保护与再生。
items.abstract_en: Interleukin-22 (IL-22) is a cytokine that regulates tissue inflammation and repair, primarily through activation of STAT3 signaling. Although its protective effects in acute pancreatitis (AP) are well established, the specific contribution of its receptor, IL-22Ra1, and the underlying signaling mechanisms remain incompletely defined. Notably, the C-terminal region of IL-22Ra1, although devoid of tyrosine residues, has been reported to promote STAT3 activation through unconventional mechanisms. Here, we investigated the role of IL-22Ra1 and its C-terminal (STAT3-associated) domain in a mouse model of caerulein-induced AP. We show that deletion of the C-terminal region of IL-22Ra1 markedly reduces STAT3 activation in the pancreas, confirming its role in amplifying canonical signaling. Unexpectedly, this reduction does not worsen pancreatic injury. In contrast, both IL-22- and IL-22Ra1-deficient mice develop more severe pancreatitis, characterized by increased serum amylase levels, exacerbated inflammatory responses, and enhanced tissue damage. Notably, IL-22Ra1 deficiency results in a more severe phenotype than IL-22 deficiency alone, indicating that IL-22Ra1 mediates protective effects beyond IL-22 signaling. Consistently, acinar-to-ductal metaplasia during the regenerative phase is impaired in both IL-22- and IL-22Ra1-deficient mice but preserved upon C-terminal truncation. Together, these findings identify IL-22Ra1 as a central regulator of pancreatic protection through mechanisms that are independent of maximal STAT3 activation and extend beyond IL-22 itself, suggesting the involvement of additional IL-22Ra1 ligands. These results support the exploration of receptor-activating strategies, such as agonistic antibodies, to promote tissue protection and regeneration.
items.journal: Journal of cell communication and signaling
items.summary_cn: IL-22Rα1通过不依赖其C端STAT3扩增结构域的机制保护胰腺损伤，且其缺失导致比IL-22缺失更严重的胰腺炎表型，提示存在其他配体介导的保护作用。

items.title_cn: 瑞典早期胃癌治疗：一项全国性注册队列研究
items.title_en: Treatment of early gastric cancer in Sweden: A nationwide registry-based cohort study.
items.abstract_cn: 背景与目的：内镜切除术（ER）是早期胃癌的成熟治疗方案。既往研究主要基于亚洲患者人群。本研究旨在基于瑞典全国癌症登记数据，评估该国早期胃癌的治疗策略与预后。方法：我们利用瑞典食管癌与胃癌国家登记数据开展了一项全国性人群队列研究。纳入2006年至2022年间所有接受手术或ER治疗的pT1N0M0期胃癌或高级别异型增生患者。主要终点为5年总生存率，次要终点包括住院时长、30天及90天死亡率、术后并发症。结果：共纳入278例患者，其中189例（68.0%）接受手术，89例（32.0%）接受ER。两组基线参数（年龄、性别、吸烟状况、ASA评分）具有可比性，但手术组临床T分期更高。手术组104例患者中67例（64.4%）实现5年总生存，ER组37例患者中24例（64.9%）实现5年总生存。多变量Cox回归分析显示两组间无显著差异（结论：本项基于人群的研究表明，ER与手术治疗早期胃癌的5年总生存率相当。ER与更短的住院时间及更少的术后并发症相关。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Endoscopic resection (ER) for early gastric cancer is a well-established treatment. Previous research is predominantly based on Asian patients. The aim of this study was to evaluate treatment strategies and outcomes for early gastric cancer in Sweden, based on data from a population-based cancer registry. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide population-based cohort study using data from the Swedish National Registry for Esophageal and Gastric Cancer. All patients with pT1N0M0 gastric cancer or high-grade dysplasia who underwent surgical or ER between 2006 and 2022 were included. The primary endpoint was 5-year overall survival. Secondary endpoints included length of hospital stay, 30- and 90-day mortality rates, and postoperative complications. RESULTS: In total, 278 patients were included. Of these, 189 (68.0%) underwent surgery and 89 (32.0%) ER. The two groups were comparable regarding baseline parameters (age, sex, smoking, ASA-score) but the surgery group had a higher clinical T-stage. The 5-year overall survival was 67 of 104 patients (64.4%) in the surgery group and 24 of 37 patients (64.9%) in the ER group. Multivariable Cox regression showed no difference between the groups ( CONCLUSIONS: In this population-based study, ER and surgery had comparable 5-year overall survival for early gastric cancer. ER was associated with a shorter hospital stay and fewer postoperative complications.
items.journal: Scandinavian journal of surgery : SJS : official organ for the Finnish Surgical Society and the Scandinavian Surgical Society
items.summary_cn: 该基于瑞典全国人群的研究显示，对于早期胃癌，内镜切除与手术的5年总生存率相当（64.4% vs 64.9%），且内镜切除的住院时间更短、术后并发症更少。

items.title_cn: Nexpowder减少近端结肠病变ESD术后凝血综合征的效果：一项回顾性多中心研究
items.title_en: The Effect of Nexpowder in Reducing Post-ESD Coagulation Syndrome in Proximal Colon Lesions: A Retrospective Multicenter Study.
items.abstract_cn: 背景：内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）是治疗侧向发育型肿瘤及早期结直肠癌的成熟根治性手段，但可能引发术后相关并发症，如ESD术后电凝综合征（PECS），该并发症可能增加医疗资源使用、延长住院时间并提高医疗费用。Nexpowder（Nextbiomedical Co. Ltd., 韩国仁川）是一种高黏附性止血粉末，已获美国FDA批准用于非静脉曲张性上消化道出血，并显示出预防再出血的疗效。本研究旨在评估Nexpowder预防高风险近端结直肠病变ESD术后PECS的预防性效果。方法：本回顾性多中心研究纳入2023年4月至2024年10月期间因PECS高风险病变接受结直肠ESD的患者，排除存在穿孔、肌层损伤或预防性夹闭的病例。35例患者（46.7%）预防性使用Nexpowder，40例患者（53.3%）作为对照组。PECS定义为术后出现腹痛、发热及炎症标志物升高需使用抗生素治疗。结果：共9例患者发生PECS。Nexpowder组PECS发生率（2.9% [CI 0.3-12.6]）显著低于对照组（20.0% [CI 9.9-34.2]；p=0.032）。所有病例经保守治疗后均缓解，无需手术干预。结论：Nexpowder的应用与高风险结直肠ESD术后PECS发生率显著降低相关。本研究首次提供临床证据，表明局部屏障剂可作为PECS简单有效的预防策略。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is an established curative treatment for lateral spreading tumors and early colorectal cancer, but it can cause procedure-related complications such as post-ESD coagulation syndrome (PECS), which may increase healthcare utilization, prolong hospitalization, and raise medical costs. Nexpowder (Nextbiomedical Co. Ltd., Incheon, Republic of Korea), a highly adhesive hemostatic powder approved by the U.S. FDA for nonvariceal upper gastrointestinal bleeding, has demonstrated efficacy in preventing rebleeding. This study aimed to evaluate the prophylactic efficacy of Nexpowder in preventing PECS after colorectal ESD for high-risk proximal lesions. METHODS: This retrospective multicenter study included patients who underwent colorectal ESD between April 2023 and October 2024 for PECS high-risk lesions, excluding those with perforation, muscular injury, or prophylactic clipping. Nexpowder was applied prophylactically in 35 patients (46.7%), while 40 patients (53.3%) served as controls. PECS was defined as postprocedural abdominal pain, fever, and elevated inflammatory markers requiring antibiotics. RESULTS: PECS occurred in nine patients overall. The incidence was significantly lower in the Nexpowder group (2.9% [CI 0.3-12.6]) than in the control group (20.0% [CI 9.9-34.2]; p = 0.032). All cases resolved with conservative treatment, and no surgical intervention was required. CONCLUSION: The application of Nexpowder was associated with a significant reduction in the incidence of PECS after high-risk colorectal ESD. This study provides the first clinical evidence that a topical barrier agent may serve as a simple and effective preventive strategy for PECS.
items.summary_cn: Nexpowder的应用显著降低了高危近端结直肠病变ESD术后PECS的发生率（2.9% vs 20.0%, p=0.032），首次提供了局部屏障剂作为PECS简单有效预防策略的临床证据。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
